title: 他当场反问：我的名字信仰，能让你加得起油吗
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The last month has brought the stakes of the selection into sharp belief.
segments.zh: 过去一个月，这场选举的利害关系变得尤为清晰。

segments.en: Hours, this beautiful movement was built over the past year and a half, campaigning across Michigan's biggest cities and the smallest towns.
segments.zh: 这个美好的运动在过去一年半里建立起来，走遍了密歇根最大的城市和最小的城镇。

segments.en: We spoke of a brighter, a bigger, more hopeful Michigan.
segments.zh: 我们谈论的是一个更光明、更广阔、更有希望的密歇根。

segments.en: There's an astroturfed, corporate-funded advertising campaign built to deceive and distract.
segments.zh: 有一场由企业资助、人为制造的广告战，旨在欺骗和分散注意力。

segments.en: Rather than try to unite us to contend with the crisis of gas or groceries, the opposition decided to try to divide us.
segments.zh: 反对派没有试图团结我们应对油价或食品杂货的压力，而是决定试图分裂我们。

segments.en: At first, they pointed to my name and my faith, as if to say, you know, he's a little different.
segments.zh: 起初，他们指向我的名字和信仰，仿佛在说，你知道，他有点不同。

segments.en: And when it didn't work, they tried to give me by association.
segments.zh: 当那不起作用时，他们试图通过关联来抹黑我。

segments.en: And when that didn't work, they went all in on one of the ugliest campaigns we've seen in our lifetimes.
segments.zh: 当那也不起作用时，他们全力投入了我们一生中见过的最丑陋的竞选活动之一。

segments.en: Then pointing to my name and my faith.
segments.zh: 然后指向我的名字和信仰。

segments.en: But we all know that my name and my faith aren't the reason you can't afford your gas.
segments.zh: 但我们都知道，我的名字和信仰并不是你加不起油的原因。

segments.en: Not the reason you can't afford your groceries. Not the reason you can't see a doctor.
segments.zh: 这不是你买不起食品杂货的原因。也不是你看不起医生的原因。

segments.en: Now, as I was campaigning, some of you would come up and ask, how come you don't hit back?
segments.zh: 在我竞选期间，有些人会走过来问我，你为什么不反击？

segments.en: How come you don't call them braces or hateful?
segments.zh: 你为什么不称他们为偏执或仇恨？
